q: The Lorenz attractor is an example of a strange attractor. 'Strange' means:
opts: It has non-integer Hausdorff dimension (fractal geometry)
exp: Strange attractors have fractal (non-integer) Hausdorff dimension, unlike classical attractors (fixed points: dimension 0, limit cycles: dimension 1, tori: integer dimensions). The Lorenz attractor has dimension ≈2.06.
